decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - A Conservatin Area type roof light, which is flush fitting with the existing roof tile measuring 640mm x 610mm shall be aligned with the existing rear dormer window gable 500mm above the gable.

Condition : 2 - The permission for three sunpipes (01234/30/P3 and 1234/30/L8) is herewith revoked.  Only one conservation type rooflight measuring 640mm x 610mm can be fitted to the rear roof slope.  Other sunpies cannot be fitted in conjunction with the approved roof light.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Installation of roof lights to rear elevation of dwellinghouse.
